name: gk-ventures
description: G|K Ventures - kadawalegalservices.com (React + NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:setup: npm --prefix server run db:migrate && npm --prefix server run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix server run start:dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
